weapons.name: Han 86
weapons.about: South Korean 5.56 service rifle. Fast fire rate with moderate damage, so it works up close and at range.

apex.name: Han X20 Skybreaker
apex.about: Adds a targeting optic and a 20mm airburst launcher that detonates over the target. Built for flushing cover; direct impacts are duds.

weapons.name: M4
weapons.about: Full-auto all-rounder that adapts to almost any fight.

apex.name: M4 Hurricane
apex.about: Top-loading, high-capacity 5.7x28mm conversion. Lighter, quicker to handle and faster firing.

weapons.name: Hyeon Burst
weapons.about: North Korean 6.8mm prototype with a hard-hitting burst.

apex.name: Hyeon Hyperburst
apex.about: Opens with a very fast three-round burst, then rolls into slower, controlled full-auto.

weapons.name: Patriot XMR
weapons.about: Heavy-hitting full-auto with strong recoil. Rewards controlled fire at mid to long range.

apex.name: Patriot XMR Volt
apex.about: Underbarrel launcher that fires a spread of stun darts. Not lethal, but sets targets up for the kill.

weapons.name: Kastov 762
weapons.about: 7.62x39 full-auto. Big damage per shot, firm recoil.

apex.name: Kastov ARC
apex.about: Disruption barrel with a built-in optic. Its RF pulse stuns players, knocks out electronics and destabilizes vehicles.

weapons.name: Oden
weapons.about: 12.7x55 bullpup. Brutal damage at a slow fire rate.

apex.name: Oden Sentinel
apex.about: Converts it into a semi-auto sniper with a bipod, suppressor and sniper scope.

weapons.name: Axion
weapons.about: Subsonic .300 BLK rifle. Slower fire rate, strong at most ranges, and hides enemy skulls on kills.

apex.name: Axion Clearcut
apex.about: Chainsaw-style rear grip, handlebar foregrip, hip laser and canted sights for fast hipfire rushing.

weapons.name: Cronen Squall
weapons.about: 6.8 Wrath open-bolt bullpup. Accurate at range with heavy damage and manageable recoil.

apex.name: Cronen Maelstrom
apex.about: Fires a missile you steer with an infrared laser while aiming. Works unguided, but loses effect at long range.

weapons.name: ISO Nightshade
weapons.about: 9mm full-auto with a fast fire rate. Balanced control, mobility and close-range damage.

apex.name: ISO Trace
apex.about: Rounds tag targets on hit, and the optic tracks their movement as a red dot.

weapons.name: VEL 46
weapons.unlockNote: Activision's post lists both Level 5 and Level 13. Two of three sources say 13.
weapons.about: 4.6x30mm. Excellent mobility with smooth, predictable recoil.

apex.name: VEL 46 Snap
apex.about: Tactical sling for very fast weapon swaps. Gives Quick Draw when paired with Overkill.

weapons.name: Wz.55 Striga
weapons.unlockNote: Activision's post lists both Level 18 and Level 21. Two of three sources say 21.
weapons.about: 9x18mm with top-tier mobility and recoil control. Low fire rate, hits hard, hides skulls on kills.

apex.name: WZ.55 Striga Rampage
apex.about: Akimbo conversion that doubles your close-range output.

weapons.name: PPSh-41
weapons.unlockNote: Activision's post lists both Level 27 and Level 30. Two of three sources say 27.
weapons.about: Drum-fed classic with the highest fire rate at launch and a huge magazine.

apex.name: PPSh-41 Ember
apex.about: Underbarrel that fires bursts of incendiary rounds, leaving fire on the ground for area control.

weapons.name: X-58 Nyx
weapons.unlockNote: Activision's post lists both Level 34 and Level 46. Two of three sources say 34.
weapons.about: 5.8x21mm SMG with a built-in suppressor. Reliable close to mid range.

apex.name: X-58 Void
apex.about: Extra-quiet subsonic setup that hides skulls and shrinks enemy hit indicators.

weapons.name: Rezi 12
weapons.about: Fast-cycling semi-auto 12-gauge for close range.

apex.name: Rezi 12 Enforcer
apex.about: Switches to pump-action and adds a side-saddle of explosive slugs for longer reach.

weapons.name: Warlord
weapons.about: Dual-tube pump-action. Big capacity, slow to reload.

apex.name: Warlord Lumen
apex.about: Blinding strobe that fires when you aim down sights. Recharges between uses.

weapons.name: FiNN LMG
weapons.about: Light, belt-fed 5.56 LMG with very stable full-auto recoil.

apex.name: FiNN Adverse
apex.about: Raises the fire rate past its limits. Long sprays overheat it until it cools down.

weapons.name: Type 73
weapons.about: Korean 7.62x54r LMG. Heavy and slow to handle, but hits hard at mid and long range.

apex.name: Type 73 Assault
apex.about: Top-mounted magazine of explosive rounds. Low capacity, huge stopping power.

weapons.name: APOC-338
weapons.about: .338 belt-fed. Devastating damage, slower fire rate, punishing recoil.

apex.name: APOC-338 Praetor
apex.about: Ten-round belt that locks it to semi-auto. Lighter, with heavier hits per round.

weapons.name: MAR-9
weapons.about: Semi-auto 7.62 DMR with controllable recoil for mid to long range.

apex.name: MAR-9 Auto
apex.about: Full-auto conversion with a high fire rate and more stopping power.

weapons.name: Oris 8.6
weapons.about: Light bolt-action in 8.6 Blackout. Compact, smooth, and hides skulls on kills.

apex.name: Oris 8.6 Razor
apex.about: Receiver-mounted module holding up to three throwing knives.

weapons.name: Mosin-Nagant
weapons.about: Old-school bolt-action that still hits hard at long range.

apex.name: Mosin Harpoon
apex.about: Spring-loaded bayonet you can launch and pick back up. Also extends melee lunge.

weapons.name: KG-7 Vulcan
weapons.about: High-capacity bolt-action with a quicker fire rate than most snipers.

apex.name: KG-7 Drillcharge
apex.about: Side-mounted rounds that drill into a surface, then detonate.

weapons.name: Astaroth .57
weapons.unlockNote: Activision's post lists both Level 10 and Level 25. Two of three sources say 25.
weapons.about: 14.5mm heavy hitter. One clean hit ends the fight.

apex.name: Astaroth .57 Infiltrator
apex.about: Sonar and radio pulses reveal enemies behind cover. Magazine drops to 1.

weapons.name: Signal 50
weapons.unlockNote: Activision's post lists both Level 35 and Level 50. Two of three sources say 50.
weapons.about: .50 cal anti-materiel rifle with a recoil-reducing barrel for steady follow-ups.

apex.name: Signal Inferno
apex.about: Incendiary .50 cal rounds with much more damage to vehicles and killstreaks.

weapons.name: SANG 9mm
weapons.about: Quick follow-up shots with very little recoil.

apex.name: SANG Breach
apex.about: Underbarrel that holds one 12-gauge shell for close calls.

weapons.name: Krait P68
weapons.about: Semi-auto .45 with controllable recoil. Subsonic, so it hides skulls on kills.

apex.name: Krait P68 Commando
apex.about: Icepick-grip tactical knife in the off hand. Better melee damage and lunge, steadier recoil.

weapons.name: .50 GS
weapons.about: Hard-hitting .50 cal sidearm, if you can control it.

apex.name: GS Magna
apex.about: Full-auto .50 GS. Huge firepower, not built for accuracy.

weapons.name: Mojave .357
weapons.about: .357 revolver with big close-range damage.

apex.name: Mojave Lawless
apex.about: Fan the hammer for rapid hipfire shots.

weapons.name: PILA
weapons.about: Portable anti-air launcher with guided and unguided missiles. Arms after 11 m, but always detonates on vehicles.

weapons.name: RPG-8
weapons.about: Unguided anti-vehicle rockets. Arms after 9 m, but always detonates on vehicles.

weapons.name: JOKR
weapons.about: Lock-on launcher that hits vehicles from above, where armor is thinnest.

weapons.name: PM-40 Anvil
weapons.about: Pump-action 43mm grenade launcher for clearing rooms at close and mid range.

weapons.name: FSS Carbon Edge 1095
weapons.about: Carbon-steel combat knife. Fast and quiet up close.

tacticals.name: Snapshot Grenade
tacticals.about: Briefly reveals nearby enemies to your team.

tacticals.name: Concussion Grenade
tacticals.about: Slows enemy reactions and blurs their vision.

tacticals.name: Shock Stick
tacticals.about: Sticks to surfaces, shocks enemies, wrecks equipment and scrambles vehicles.

tacticals.name: Decoy Grenade
tacticals.about: Fakes gunfire, movement and radar pings.

tacticals.name: Stim
tacticals.about: Starts health regen right away, refreshes Tactical Sprint and cuts flash and stun effects.

tacticals.name: Screamer Mine
tacticals.about: Proximity mine that suppresses and marks enemies in range.

lethals.name: Proximity Mine
lethals.about: Pops up and detonates in the air. Can stick to vehicles.

lethals.name: Trip Wire
lethals.about: Thrown trap. Multiple wires link into a network.

lethals.name: Thermite
lethals.about: Sticky incendiary. Heavy damage to vehicles and armor.

fieldUpgrades.name: Portable Radar
fieldUpgrades.about: Pings nearby enemies on a loop.

fieldUpgrades.name: DDOS
fieldUpgrades.about: Pulse that jams nearby enemy electronics.

fieldUpgrades.name: Munitions Box
fieldUpgrades.about: Ammo and equipment for your team.

fieldUpgrades.name: SAM Airburst Turret
fieldUpgrades.about: Portable turret that shoots down air threats.

fieldUpgrades.name: Riot Shield
fieldUpgrades.about: Plantable cover that can be destroyed.

fieldUpgrades.name: Trophy System
fieldUpgrades.about: Destroys up to three incoming projectiles.

fieldUpgrades.name: Seeker Drone
fieldUpgrades.about: Hunts down nearby enemies and reveals them.

fieldUpgrades.name: Inflatable Decoy
fieldUpgrades.about: Pops a decoy dummy on proximity or on command.

fieldUpgrades.name: Smoke Wall
fieldUpgrades.about: Rocket that lays a long trail of smoke.

killstreaks.name: UAV
killstreaks.about: Shows enemies on the minimap. 150 health after the launch patch.

killstreaks.name: Bomb Glider
killstreaks.about: Hand-launched glider with an explosive payload.

killstreaks.name: Care Package
killstreaks.about: Drops a random killstreak at your position.

killstreaks.name: Impact Warhead
killstreaks.about: Drills through several floors before exploding.

killstreaks.name: Artillery Beacon
killstreaks.about: Heat-seeking missiles home in on a thrown beacon.

killstreaks.name: Wheelson
killstreaks.about: Autonomous rover that hunts targets or guards you.

killstreaks.name: Missile Salvo
killstreaks.about: Aerial platform that fires lock-on missiles.

killstreaks.name: Railgun Sentry
killstreaks.about: Hypersonic railgun you can deploy as a sentry.

killstreaks.name: Attack Helicopter
killstreaks.about: Helicopter that covers the map and tracks targets.

killstreaks.name: Deathstalker
killstreaks.about: Remote helicopter with twin turrets that overheat.

killstreaks.name: Advanced UAV
killstreaks.about: Live enemy positions and facing. Can't be locked on.

killstreaks.name: Argonaut
killstreaks.about: Heavy armor suit with a cluster grenade launcher and burst sidearm.

killstreaks.name: Air Lockdown
killstreaks.about: Bombing runs plus anti-air cover while active.

perks.name: Quick Fix
perks.about: Kills and objective play start health regen right away.

perks.name: High Alert
perks.about: Your vision pulses when an enemy outside your view spots you.

perks.name: Ghost
perks.about: Hidden from callouts, UAVs, Portable Radars and Heartbeat Sensors.

perks.name: Resupply
perks.about: Equipment recharges, +1 max capacity, faster Field Upgrade charge.

perks.name: Kill Chain
perks.about: Killstreak kills earn half streak points.

perks.name: Blood Rush
perks.about: Enables Tactical Sprint. Kills refill your stamina.

perks.name: Bomb Squad
perks.about: Less damage from non-killstreak explosives, fuse resets on pickup, no knockdown.

perks.name: Fast Hands
perks.about: Faster reloads, equipment use and weapon swaps.

perks.name: Birdseye
perks.about: Zoomed-out minimap. UAV and radar pings show enemy facing.

perks.name: Lethal Reach
perks.about: Longer throws with a visible arc. Weapon butt uses your knife.

perks.name: Combat Grid
perks.about: See enemy equipment, killstreaks and vehicles through walls.

perks.name: Scavenger
perks.about: Enemies drop ammo on death (not launcher ammo).

perks.name: Tracker
perks.about: See enemy footprints and death markers. Your kill markers are hidden.

perks.name: Cold-Blooded
perks.about: Invisible to automated targeting, thermals, recon drones, Snapshot Grenades and High Alert.
